values./system/biography: A pre-War Nuka-World robotics engineer and skilled ghoul wastelander who maintains the park’s robots.
values./items/@4d240c8686ea9b9c/system/descript: AGI + Small Guns (TN 10), Range L, Fire Rate 2, Accurate, Night Vision, Suppressed, Two-Handed.
values./items/@6c827f4598f7e93b/system/descript: Z cannot suffer radiation damage or effects.
values./items/@2342b5b69e209a9f/system/descript: Z regains 1 HP per 3 Radiation damage prevented.
values./items/@096f45928942e3ce/system/descript: Z may fit rank 3 robot mods, reduces Repair difficulty on robots by 1, and may reprogram non-hostile robots.
values./items/@4c8384051a42e11f/system/descript: After Aiming, Z may reroll up to 2d20 on the next attack this round or 1d20 on every attack this turn.
values./items/@02617b4e12e73fe1/system/descript: Z may threaten a target within Medium with STR + Speech difficulty 2 and may reroll 1d20 on threats.
values./items/@5949564660a9bf46/system/descript: Once per combat Z adds the rifle’s Fire Rate to its damage, for 9 DC total.
values./items/@504cb535245b76b4/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
